C0136.title: Using Mobile Phone Slow-Recharge Services to Launder Money for Gambling Crime Syndicates
C0136.summary: Police in Zibo, Shandong dismantled a major criminal case involving aiding information network criminal activities, with a total amount exceeding 20 billion yuan. The criminal group exploited mobile phone slow-recharge services, programmatically linking top-up orders to gambling websites.
